Traits Paradise-Touched, divination, exploration

Ask one question about any past event that had at least one witness whose mind was ever uploaded. The GM answers fully and truthfully — this is not a Static result and is not subject to a flat check. You then gain 1 Signal Drift. This happens whether the answer helped you, whether you understood it, and whether you liked it; there is no roll and no way to avoid the point.
